family_mean_scope: Descriptive means over fixed seeds, not 30000 independent objects
memory_scope: RSS maximum and sampled MPS driver allocations on unified memory; not additive

paired.interval_scope: group/object sampling conditional on these three training seeds; physical independence of singleton IDs is unverified
paired.pairing: one sampled group multiplicity shared by A/B and every seed; seeds are not extra objects

sensitivity.assumptions: Validation discordance transports to test; independent observed units; normal approximation. Selected validation is optimistic. Unknown physical dependencies can widen intervals; this is not a power guarantee.
